items.texto: Citar la fuente de cada imagen, texto o video que usas en tus producciones.
items.escena: A clay photo card, a page and a small video card each tied with a thin string to a small book at the end, as if credited to it

items.texto: Declarar quién eres, qué intereses tienes y de dónde proviene la información.
items.escena: A clay figure wearing a big blank name badge standing openly behind a transparent glass desk with papers visible

items.texto: Difundir contenido sexual íntimo de una persona sin su consentimiento.
items.escena: A clay smartphone sending a sealed private envelope with a small heart seal out to many other phones

items.texto: Pedir consentimiento antes de publicar imágenes o datos de otra persona.
items.escena: A clay figure holding a camera and politely asking another smiling clay figure who gives a thumbs up

items.texto: Producir un video con música protegida sin permiso del artista.
items.escena: A clay video camera on a tripod next to a vinyl record with music notes flowing into the camera

items.texto: Publicar contenido que estereotipe o denigre a un grupo por su género o etnia.
items.escena: A clay smartphone showing a post with a caricature drawing of a person

items.texto: Usar imágenes con licencia libre de Unsplash, Pixabay o Wikimedia Commons.
items.escena: An open clay box full of colourful photo cards of landscapes and animals

items.texto: Verificar que la información sea verdadera antes de compartirla.
items.escena: A clay figure checking a newspaper with a magnifying glass while holding a smartphone with the share button not yet pressed

A clay figure sneakily tracing another person's drawing through a sheet of paper with a pencil
